headline: Dense coastal district of Xətai with high paved road network share

tags.reason: Secondary apartments average 1,973 AZN/m², below the Baku median of 2,084 AZN/m².
The area has 3 metro stations, 36 bus routes, and an affordability index of 63.
Kindergarten density is 3.02 per 10,000 residents, exceeding the municipal median of 2.32.

summary: Xətai has a population density of 9,260 residents per km², well above the Baku median of 2,890.5. The local property market has 16,203 listings, where 73% hold a title extract (çıxarış) and secondary flat prices average 1,973 AZN/m² compared to the municipal median of 2,084 AZN/m². While 95% of known road surfaces are paved, 78.2% of the district's 343 km road network remains unrecorded. Daily amenities and healthcare sit below the city baseline, registering convenience and healthcare index ratings of 23 and 24 respectively.
strengths: High paved share among roads with recorded surfaces (95% paved; Baku median 83.1%)
Kindergarten density above the city baseline (3.02 per 10,000 residents; Baku median 2.32)
Secondary flat prices below the municipal median (1,973 AZN/m²; Baku median 2,084 AZN/m²)
weaknesses: Low pharmacy provision relative to population (0.86 per 10,000 residents; Baku median 2.24)
Hospital capacity lagging behind city average (1.55 per 10,000 residents; Baku median 2.75)
Subdued day-to-day amenity density index (rahatliq score 23; Baku median 51.5)
best_for: Commuters relying on multi-modal public transit (3 metro stations, 4 rail stations, and 36 bus routes)
Buyers seeking secondary housing under the city median price (1,973 AZN/m²)
watch_out: A total of 78.2% of road surface types across the 343 km road network are unknown in OpenStreetMap
Land pricing (35,000 AZN/sot) is a mock demo value and cannot be used for analysis
27% of available property listings lack a registered title extract ("çıxarış")
confidence_note: OpenStreetMap mapping coverage is rated high, though 78.2% of road surfaces lack classification. Apartment values are drawn from active listing samples, whereas the land price figure is mock data.
